# semgrep for the `semgrep` job in .github/workflows/test-and-lint.yml, installed with
# `pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r .github/requirements/semgrep.txt`.

# Every package semgrep needs on the runner (ubuntu-latest, x86_64, CPython 3.11), pinned with the
# sha256 of each wheel pypi.org publishes for that platform. Nothing here is the package's own
# dependency; poetry.lock does not see it. Regenerate when bumping semgrep: resolve the closure with
#
#   pip download semgrep==<version> -d <dir> --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.11 \
#     --implementation cp --abi cp311 --abi abi3 --abi none \
#     --platform manylinux_2_39_x86_64 ... --platform manylinux1_x86_64 --platform any
#
# then pin each downloaded wheel's version, with every digest pypi.org's JSON API
# (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json) lists for a wheel that installs on that target.
# Check that each downloaded file's own sha256 is among them.
